solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, number freed: 16 down to 15); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Energetic person outside pit to behave arrogantly

indicators.note: the energetic person goes outside, wrapping around the pit

parts.note: a doer is someone who gets things done
a mine is a pit dug for coal or ore

explanation.surface: A busy go-getter standing outside a coal pit starts lording it over everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: To lord it over others is to act in an overbearing, arrogant way.

clue.text: Moves quickly to avoid waterbirds

definitions.meaning: to duck a blow is to dodge it by moving quickly
the birds that swim on ponds, plural

explanation.surface: Birds on a pond dart away to escape something.
explanation.definitionFit: Dodging by bobbing down is one sense; the familiar web-footed birds are the other.

clue.text: Republic first to move on out-of-date eggs

indicators.note: first to picks the opening letter of the word move

parts.note: old means out of date or stale
ova is the Latin plural for eggs

explanation.surface: A country decides first to act on its stale eggs.
explanation.definitionFit: Moldova is an Eastern European republic between Romania and Ukraine.

clue.text: None breathe nervously, close to indecency

indicators.note: acting nervously suggests jittery disorder, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Nobody dares breathe, anxious that something is almost obscene.
explanation.definitionFit: A joke that is risqué or bordering on bad taste is described by this idiom.

clue.text: Self-centredness, say, starts to offend in some measure

parts.note: eg, for example, is signalled by say

indicators.note: starts to takes the first letter of each of the four following words

explanation.surface: Vanity, for instance, is partly what begins to cause offence.
explanation.definitionFit: Egoism is an excessive focus on oneself and one's own interests.

clue.text: Setback: British crestfallen

parts.note: feeling low means dejected or downcast

explanation.surface: A news-style headline: a reverse leaves the British downcast.
explanation.definitionFit: A setback is a disappointing shock, the same sense as a blow to one's hopes.

clue.text: Collective knowledge about island river

indicators.note: about means the knowledge word goes round the island letter

parts.note: lore is the traditional knowledge held by a group

explanation.surface: Folk tradition tells tales of an island in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: The Loire is the longest river in France.

clue.text: House in downs I refurbished? Right

indicators.note: refurbishing a building remakes it, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether their house on the downs is properly renovated.
explanation.definitionFit: Windsor is the royal house of the British monarchy; House means a dynasty here.

clue.text: Working together, almost arrest bishop before speech

indicators.note: the bishop comes ahead of the speech in the answer
almost means the word is cut short by its final letter

parts.note: to collar someone is slang for arresting them
B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
an oration is a formal speech

explanation.surface: Police and churchman cooperate: nearly nabbing a bishop just before his sermon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last letter of COLLAR, leaving COLLA.
explanation.definitionFit: Collaboration is the act of jointly working with others towards a shared goal.

clue.text: Making concessions as policy, change a steppe name

indicators.note: change signals that the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Giving ground diplomatically, a regime renames a steppe.
explanation.definitionFit: Appeasement is the policy of conceding to an aggressor to avoid conflict, as in 1930s diplomacy.

clue.text: Second left to see football, say

parts.note: port is the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a second early to go and watch the football.
explanation.definitionFit: Football is an example of a game played competitively, signalled by 'say'.

clue.text: Meals at higher level in Sunday School

indicators.note: the higher-level word sits inside the abbreviation for Sunday School

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for Sunday School
upper means situated higher up

explanation.surface: Food is served on an upper floor at a church's Sunday School.
explanation.definitionFit: Suppers are evening meals, so the plural matches 'Meals'.

clue.text: Singular place of safety for beardless?

parts.note: S is the grammar abbreviation for singular
a haven is a refuge or safe harbour

explanation.surface: A peculiar refuge for those who have no beards, it wonders.
explanation.definitionFit: A face that has been shaved clean has no beard, hence the question mark for a looser fit.

clue.text: Portion in southeast region initially accompanied by French wine (good)

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the word region

parts.note: vin is French for wine

explanation.surface: A helping in a southeastern area comes with decent French wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A serving is a single helping of food, a portion on the plate.

clue.text: Near the end some regret talking back

indicators.note: back means the run of letters is then read from right to left
some signals a run of letters taken from within the following words

explanation.surface: Late in the day someone regrets answering back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'some' takes RETTAL from 'regret talking'; 'back' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: The latter part of something is the part closer to its conclusion.

clue.text: Act deceitfully also, we hear — note I'm taken in

indicators.note: we hear signals that the word is spoken and replaced by one sounding alike

parts.note: too means also

indicators.note: taken in puts the contraction inside the musical note

parts.note: te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale
I'm is written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone also cheats, it is reported, and admits to being fooled.
explanation.definitionFit: To two-time a partner is to be unfaithful by secretly seeing someone else.

clue.text: Give up tenure or commit oneself again?

definitions.meaning: to step down formally from a post
to put one's signature to a contract once more

explanation.surface: Should one quit the job or sign up for another term?
explanation.definitionFit: Quitting a position is one sense; split as re-sign, it means signing again.

clue.text: Speak disapprovingly to salesman and wander off

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative
to rove is to roam or wander

explanation.surface: A boss scolds a travelling salesman who keeps straying off course.
explanation.definitionFit: To rebuke or scold someone is to tell them off disapprovingly.

clue.text: Crazy child's place to go

definitions.meaning: informal British for mad or daft
a small toilet bowl used by toddlers

explanation.surface: A child running wild looks for somewhere to relieve themselves.
explanation.definitionFit: Being slightly mad is one sense; the toddler's toilet is the other.

clue.text: In recession manage hospital for period

indicators.note: receding means going backwards, so the word for manage is read in reverse

parts.note: to cope is to manage or get by
H is the abbreviation for hospital, as on road signs

explanation.surface: During an economic downturn, a hospital is run on a tight budget for a time.
explanation.definitionFit: An epoch is a distinct era or age in history.

clue.text: Surprised expression about longing for doglike mammal

indicators.note: about means the exclamation goes round the longing word

parts.note: ha is an exclamation of surprise
a yen is a strong desire

explanation.surface: Someone exclaims in surprise at their longing for a dog-like animal.
explanation.definitionFit: The hyena is an African scavenging carnivore resembling a dog.

clue.text: Fashionable article, one maybe containing tobacco policy, on its way

parts.note: in means trendy or fashionable
the is the definite article
a pipe is filled with tobacco for smoking
a party line is its official policy

explanation.surface: A trendy item, a pipe perhaps, with a smoking policy soon to arrive.
explanation.definitionFit: Something planned and under way but not yet delivered is said to be coming, an idiom.

clue.text: Good year, oddly, for painter

indicators.note: oddly takes the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of the two words Good year

explanation.surface: A fine vintage year, strangely, for some artist.
explanation.definitionFit: Francisco Goya was a celebrated Spanish artist of the late 18th and early 19th centuries.

clue.text: One greatly disliked bandana the maid displays

indicators.note: displays says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A servant wears a hated headscarf that everyone loathes.
explanation.definitionFit: Something or someone detested is called an object of loathing in this sense.
